paite: "Huan nang mihing tapa, namsau hiam mahmah la inla, na lu leh na khamul metna ding in sammetmi tem zang in; huan bukna la inla, sam khen in.
heading: Ezekiel Samtanna
english: “You, son of man, take a sharp sword. You shall take it as a barber’s razor to yourself, and shall cause it to pass over your head and over your beard. Then take balances to weigh and divide the hair.

paite: Seh thum a khen seh khat sim a a-om sung nite abei hun chiang in khopi lai a mei ah na hal ding ahi; seh thum a khen seh khat nawn na la dia, akim ah namsau in na satnen ding ahi; huan, seh thum a khen seh khat nawn huih mutleng ding in na thehzak ding a, ke'n namsau in ka delhzui ding hi.
english: A third part you shall burn in the fire in the middle of the city, when the days of the siege are fulfilled. You shall take a third part, and strike with the sword around it. A third part you shall scatter to the wind, and I will draw out a sword after them.

paite: Huan tawmchik na la ding a, na puanaktual mong ah na tun ding hi.
english: You shall take a small number of these and bind them in the folds of your robe.

paite: Hiaite lak a tam lou na la ding a, mei ah na thehlut ding a, na hal ding ahi; huai a kipan in Israel inkote tengteng ah mei ahong pawt ding," achi hi.
english: Of these again you shall take, and cast them into the middle of the fire, and burn them in the fire. From it a fire will come out into all the house of Israel.

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Hiai Jerusalem khua ahi, namte' laizang ah ka koih a, akim ah gamte a-om hi.
english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘This is Jerusalem. I have set her in the middle of the nations, and countries are around her.

paite: Namte sang a nakpi a gitlouhna hih zaw in ka thugel tung ah ahel a, akim a gamte sang a thupizaw in ka dan bawl tung ah ahel uhi. Ka thugelte apaikhia ua, ka dan bawlte bang in a-om kei uhi."
english: She has rebelled against my ordinances in doing wickedness more than the nations, and against my statutes more than the countries that are around her; for they have rejected my ordinances, and as for my statutes, they have not walked in them.’

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Na kim a namte sang a buai hatzaw in na om a, ka dan thusehte bawl bang in na om kei a, ka thukhennate leng na zui kei ua, namte a dia ka thukhendan a na hih louh ziak un, Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi:
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Because you are more turbulent than the nations that are around you, and have not walked in my statutes, neither have kept my ordinances, neither have followed the ordinances of the nations that are around you;

paite: Ngai un, kei, kei nangawn in leng ka hon nang ahi, namte mitmuh ngei in na lak uah vaihawmna ka tangtungsak ding hi.
english: therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘Behold, I, even I, am against you; and I will execute judgments among you in the sight of the nations.

paite: Na kihhuaina tengteng uh ziak in thil ka hih ngei nai louh, hih leng ka hih ngei nawn louh ding na tung uah ka hih ding hi.
english: I will do in you that which I have not done, and which I will not do anything like it any more, because of all your abominations.

paite: Huchi in pate'n na sung ah atate uh ane ding ua, tate'n leng apate uh ane ding uh; nang a mikhosuaksun tengteng ka dalhsak vek ding."
english: Therefore the fathers will eat the sons within you, and the sons will eat their fathers. I will execute judgments on you; and I will scatter the whole remnant of you to all the winds.

paite: Huchi in hiai Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi: "Na nitna leh na kihhuainate a ka mun siangthou na hihnit ziak in, kei ka hin bang in, ka hon kiamsak ding a, ka mit in ahon maih het kei ding a, ka hon hehpih sam kei ding hi.
english: Therefore as I live,’ says the Lord Yahweh, ‘surely, because you have defiled my sanctuary with all your detestable things, and with all your abominations, therefore I will also diminish you. My eye won’t spare, and I will have no pity.

paite: Seh thum a khen seh khat hipi in hiam, kial in hiam na lak uah asi ding uh; seh thum a khen seh khat nawn ka hihdalh ding a, namsau in ka delhzui ding hi."
english: A third part of you will die with the pestilence, and they will be consumed with famine within you. A third part will fall by the sword around you. A third part I will scatter to all the winds, and will draw out a sword after them.

paite: Hichibang in ka hehna ka tangtungsak ding a, atung uah ka hehna ka lungdamsak ding a, ka om anuamta ding hi; kei TOUPA'N atung ua ka hehna ka lungdamsak hun chiang in phatuamngaitak in ka genta chih atheikhe ding uh.
english: “‘Thus my anger will be accomplished, and I will cause my wrath toward them to rest, and I will be comforted. They will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken in my zeal, when I have accomplished my wrath on them.

paite: Huai lou in, na kim a namte lak ah leh vialvak tengtengte mitmuh in kho segawp leh simmohhuai in ka hon bawl ding hi.
english: “‘Moreover I will make you a desolation and a reproach among the nations that are around you, in the sight of all that pass by.

paite: Huchi in thangpai leh heh mahmah a, nakpi a taihilh a, na tung a thugelte ka tunsak hun in na kim a namte mitmuh in nuihsan leh kouna leh hilhna leh mulkimhuai na hi ding; kei TOUPA'N ka chita hi.
english: So it will be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment, to the nations that are around you, when I execute judgments on you in anger and in wrath, and in wrathful rebukes—I, Yahweh, have spoken it—

paite: Atung uah kialna thaltang hoih loutak manna ding, noumau manna ding ka hon kesak ding; na tung uah kialna ka uangsak ding a, na an uh, hinna bul ka hihse ding hi.
english: when I send on them the evil arrows of famine that are for destruction, which I will send to destroy you. I will increase the famine on you and will break your staff of bread.

paite: Huchi in na tung uah kialna leh gamsa hangte ka hon sawl ding a, ta leh nau tan in ahon laksak ding uh; hipi leh sisan suahna na lak uah aleng ding a; na tung uah namsau ka hon sawl ding, kei TOUPA'N ka chita hi, chi in.
english: I will send on you famine and evil animals, and they will bereave you. Pestilence and blood will pass through you. I will bring the sword on you. I, Yahweh, have spoken it.’”
